command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute no testcase command until owner resolution. For confirmed Type 12, securely collect complete `dmidecode -t 12`; for a confirmed alternative, use its explicitly approved full-structure command and matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The row's Type 12 title, Count, before/after reboot requirement, same-code identity, source script and 5/5-minute estimates remain visible.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row item names SMBIOS Type 12 System Configuration Options, but DeepSeek command/output select Type 18 32-Bit Memory Error Information; row 1935 separately owns the same-code Type 18 variant. Executing the supplied command would leave the declared Type 12 coverage untested and blur two variants.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and conflict recording are complete. Test execution is package-gated on an owner structure decision, but the overall review must continue rather than counting a guessed correction.

review_improvement: Preserves the Type 12 source and distinct Type 18 same-code variant, records a formal decision question and prohibits a plausible but wrong-structure PASS.
independent_technical_reasoning: SMBIOS type selection is part of the testcase identity, not a replaceable command parameter. Type 12 contains configuration-option strings while Type 18 encodes 32-bit memory-error metadata; a clean Type 18 result says nothing about Type 12 Count or values. The duplicate code at row 1935 strengthens, rather than resolves, the ambiguity because it shows the Type 18 command likely leaked between adjacent variants.
